title: EventEnvelope
description: Mandatory envelope on every TRACE-X event (docs/EVENT_CONTRACTS.md §2, ADR-0026). Envelope fields are never nested inside payload, and payload never redefines one.

event_id.description: UUIDv7, lowercase. Time-ordered, and the deduplication key in both Redis (hot path) and Spark dropDuplicatesWithinWatermark (warm path). Carries a pattern rather than "format": "uuid" on purpose: format only says it is a UUID, while the pattern pins the VERSION NIBBLE to 7, and time-ordering is the property the dedup key and Delta index locality actually depend on.

event_type.description: Dotted and stable. Renaming is a breaking change.

schema_version.description: Matches the file suffix. Never decreases.

occurred_at.description: EVENT TIME. Drives every window and watermark. Never interchangeable with ingested_at (ADR-0026).

ingested_at.description: PROCESSING TIME. Lag measurement only; never used for business logic.

producer.description: service@semver, for provenance and blast-radius analysis.

trace_id.description: W3C trace id, propagated as a Kafka header AND in the body: headers survive Spark's transformations, bodies survive header-stripping intermediaries.

correlation_id.description: Business flow id, stable across a whole investigation.

idempotency_key.description: Deterministic hash of the semantic content. Equal keys mean equal meaning.
